info.name: Jira Pet Project (Node.js)
info.description:
The project is a task management system where users can create and manage projects and tasks, as well as interact with each other through comments. The main features include:

1. **Project Management**: The ability to create, edit, and delete projects, as well as add and remove users from projects.
    
2. **Task Management**: Creating, editing, and deleting tasks within projects, including tracking time and statuses.
    
3. **Comments**: Users can leave comments on tasks, enhancing communication and progress tracking.
    
4. **Roles and Permissions**: Support for various user roles (e.g., ADMIN) to control access to system features.
    

The project data structure includes titles, descriptions, unique identifiers, task counts, and lists of users working on the project. The system uses authentication tokens to ensure security and manage access.

## **README**

It supports two roles: **ADMIN** and **USER**.

## **Projects**:

**ADMIN:**

has access to full management of all projects.

**USER:**  
has access to view projects to which he has been added. The USER cannot create, edit, or delete any projects. The USER also cannot add or delete users in the project.

## Tasks:

**ADMIN:**

has access to full management of all tasks in all projects.

**USER:**

has access to view and edit tasks of projects to which he has been added. The USER cannot create or delete any tasks.

## Comments:

**ADMIN:**

has access to create comment, view, delete all comments under tasks in all projects. The ADMIN cannot edit other user's comments, only his own

**USER:**

has access to create comment, view all comments under tasks in projects to which he has been added. The USER cannot edit, delete other user's comments, only his own

## Statuses:

**ADMIN:**

has access to full management of all statuses.

**USER:**

has access to view all statuses. he USER cannot create, edit, or delete any statuses.

## Types:

**ADMIN:**

has access to full management of all types.

**USER:**

has access to view all statuses. he USER cannot create, edit, or delete any types.

item.name: Authorization
item.description:
### POST /users/login

- **Description**: Authenticates the user and returns a JWT token.

- **Authorization**: Not required.

- **Request Body**:
    - `email` (string, required): The user's email.
    - `password` (string, required): The user's password.

- **Response**:

    ```json
    { 
        "token": "your_jwt_token" 
    }
    ```

---

### POST /users/registration

- **Description**: Registers a new user.

- **Authorization**: Not required.

- **Request Body**:
    - `email` (string, required): The user's email.
    - `password` (string, required): The user's password.
    - `name` (string, required): The user's name.
    - `role` (string, optional): Defaults to "user".
    - `avatar` (file, optional): An optional avatar file.

- **Response**:

    ```json
    { 
        "token": "your_jwt_token" 
    }
    ```

item.name: Comments
Files
item.description:
### POST /files

- **Description**: Attaches a file to a task or a comment.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token).

- **Request Body**:

    - `taskId` (string, optional): ID of the task.
    - `commentId` (string, optional): ID of the comment.
    - `file` (file, required): File to attach.

- **Response**:

    ```json
    {
        "file": "https://...jpg"
    }
    ```

---

### DELETE /files/:fileId

- **Description**: Detaches (deletes) a file from a task or comment.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token).

- **URL Parameters**:

    - `fileId` (string, required): ID of the file to delete.

- **Response**:

    ```json
    {
        "deleted": true
    }
    ```

item.name: Projects
item.description:
### GET /projects

- **Description**: Retrieves all projects.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token).

- **Response**:

    ```json
    {
        "projects": [
            {
                "title": "Project title",
                "description": "Project description",
                "id": "12",
                "tasksCount": 0,
                "users": [
                    {
                        "id": 1,
                        "name": "User name",
                        "email": "example@gmail.com",
                        "role": "USER",
                        "avatar": null
                    }
                ]
            }
        ]
    }
    ```

---

### GET /projects/:projectId

- **Description**: Retrieves a project by projectId.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token).

- **Response**:

    ```json
    {
        "project": {
            "title": "Project title",
            "description": "Project description",
            "id": "12",
            "tasksCount": 1,
            "users": [
                {
                    "id": 1,
                    "name": "User name",
                    "email": "example@gmail.com",
                    "role": "USER",
                    "avatar": null
                }
            ],
            "tasks": [
                {
                    "id": 6,
                    "title": "Task with files title",
                    "description": "Task with file description",
                    "timeAllotted": null,
                    "status": {
                        "id": 1,
                        "title": "Status title"
                    },
                    "type": {
                        "id": 1,
                        "title": "Type title"
                    },
                    "user": {
                        "id": 1,
                        "name": "User name",
                        "email": "example@gmail.com",
                        "role": "USER",
                        "avatar": null
                    },
                    "files": [
                        {
                            "id": 4,
                            "name": "image.jpg"
                        }
                    ]
                }
            ]
        }
    }
    ```

---

### POST /projects

- **Description**: Creates a new project.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token). ADMIN only.

- **Request Body**:

    - `title` (string, required): Title of the project.
    - `description` (string, required): Description of the project.

- **Response**:

    ```json
    {
        "project": {
            "title": "Project title",
            "description": "Project description",
            "id": "12",
            "tasksCount": 0,
            "users": []
        }
    }
    ```

---

### PUT /projects/:projectId

- **Description**: Edits a project by ID.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token). ADMIN only.

- **Request Body**:

    - `title` (string, required): Updated project title.
    - `description` (string, required): Updated project description.

- **Response**:

    ```json
    {
        "project": {
            "title": "Updated title",
            "description": "Updated description",
            "id": "12",
            "tasksCount": 0,
            "users": []
        }
    }
    ```

---

### DELETE /projects/:projectId

- **Description**: Deletes a project by ID.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token). ADMIN only.

- **Response**:

    ```json
    {
        "deleted": true
    }
    ```

---

### GET /projects/:projectId/users

- **Description**: Retrieves all members (users) of a project by projectId.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token).

- **Response**:

    ```json
    {
        "users": [
            {
                "id": 1,
                "name": "AdminUser",
                "email": "admin@gmail.com",
                "role": "ADMIN",
                "avatar": null
            },
            {
                "id": 2,
                "name": "User",
                "email": "user@gmail.com",
                "role": "USER",
                "avatar": null
            }
        ]
    }
    ```

---

### POST /projects/:projectId/users

- **Description**: Adds a user to a project.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token). ADMIN only.

- **Request Body**:

    - `userId` (string, required): ID of the user to add.

- **Response**:

    ```json
    {
        "added": true
    }
    ```

---

### DELETE /projects/:projectId/users

- **Description**: Removes a user from a project.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token). ADMIN only.

- **Request Body**:

    - `userId` (string, required): ID of the user to remove.

- **Response**:

    ```json
    {
        "deleted": true
    }
    ```

item.name: Tasks
Statuses

### GET /statuses

- **Description**: Retrieves a list of all statuses.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token).

    ```json
                "id": "1",
                "title": "Pending",
                "color": "#ffcc00"
            }
        ]
    }
    ```

---

### POST /statuses

- **Description**: Creates a new status.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token). **ADMIN only**.

- **Request Body**:
    - `title` (string, required): The title of the status.
    - `color` (string, required): The color of the status.

    ```json
            "id": "1",
            "title": "New Status Title",
            "color": "#00ff00"
        }
    }
    ```

---

### PUT /statuses/:statusId

- **Description**: Edits an existing status by ID.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token). **ADMIN only**.

- **Request Body**:
    - `title` (string, required): Updated title of the status.
    - `color` (string, required): Updated color of the status.

- **Response**:

    ```json
    {
        "status": {
            "id": "1",
            "title": "Updated Status Title",
            "color": "#0000ff"
        }
    }
    ```

---

### DELETE /statuses/:statusId

- **Description**: Deletes a status by ID.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token). **ADMIN only**.

- **Response**:

    ```json
    {
        "deleted": true
    }
    ```

item.name: User
item.description:
### GET /users

- **Description**: Retrieves a list of all users.

- **Authorization**: Required.

- **Response:**

    ```json
    {
        "users": [
            {
                "id": 1,
                "email": "user@example.com",
                "name": "John Doe",
                "role": "user",
                "avatar": "image.jpg"
            }
        ]
    }
    ```

---

### PUT /users

- **Description**: Edits the current user profile.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token).

- **Request Body:**

    - `name` (string, required): The user's updated name.
    - `avatar` (file, optional): An updated avatar file.

- **Response:**

    ```json
    { 
        "updated": true 
    }
    ```

---

### DELETE /users/avatar

- **Description**: Deletes the current user's avatar.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token).

- **Response:**

    ```json
    { 
        "updated": true 
    }
    ```

---

### POST /users/me

- **Description**: Retrieves the current authenticated user's details.

- **Authorization**: Required (Bearer Token).

- **Response:**

    ```json
    {
        "user": {
            "id": 1,
            "email": "user@example.com",
            "name": "John Doe",
            "role": "user",
            "avatar": "image.jpg"
        }
    }
    ```
